chunks: A garment does not make a man junub, nor does a man make a garment junub.

key_terms.آخَرَ: another; indicating a separate transmitted report
key_terms.يُجْنِبُ: causes to be in a state of janabah

ai.seo_question: Does a garment make a person ritually impure, or does a junub person make clothing ritually impure?
ai.summary: This report states that janabah is not transmitted merely between a person and a garment. It indicates that clothing itself does not render a person junub, nor does a junub person automatically render the garment junub.
